brief.goal: Add configurable account tags/labels with color settings so users can visually identify which account an email, task, or calendar event belongs to.
brief.constraints: Tech stack: Electron + React + TypeScript + SQLite. Must follow existing IPC patterns (contextBridge allowlist, registerHandlers). Database migration: add color column to accounts table. PRD requirements: REQ-003 (account badges), REQ-004 (per-account identity), REQ-016 (source badges). Issue #32 specifies: preset palette + custom hex input, colors persist across restarts. Must work in both light and dark themes.
brief.non_goals: Calendar event coloring (blocked by issue #17, not implemented yet). Bulk color operations (assign all, reset all). Color import/export functionality. Modifying core email/task data structures (only add color metadata to accounts).
success_criteria: Color picker offers preset palette (8-10 colors) + custom hex input in Settings
Email list shows colored account indicator (dot or left-border) per email
Task list shows colored account indicator per task
Account filter dropdown shows color dots next to account names
Colors persist across app restarts (SQLite storage)
Default colors auto-assigned on account connection (distinct per account)
Colors work in both light and dark themes

steps.prompt: Write a feature specification for the goal below. Include requirements, constraints, and measurable success criteria.
Explore approaches and tradeoffs for the goal below. Consider multiple viable solutions and present a recommended design.
Review the specification and interview the team to resolve any vague success criteria or missing constraints.
Break down the specification into an implementation plan with ordered, verifiable tasks.
Adversarially review the plan before implementation. Challenge every non-trivial decision.
Implement the next pending task from the plan. Follow test-driven practices.
Review the implementation against the specification and success criteria. Verify independently — you are the checker, not the maker.

specify.output: Wrote comprehensive feature spec with source references, IPC channel spec, database migration, preset palette, UI design, and file change list.

brainstorm.output: Explored approaches for color picker UX, badge design, and theme handling. Confirmed spec design decisions.

clarify.output: Identified 10 spec gaps and resolved them: hex validation, edge cases, UI inconsistencies, Zod schema, default color assignment.

plan.output: Created 8-task implementation plan across 3 layers: database, IPC/preload, UI components.

analyze.output: Adversarially reviewed plan, found 8 issues, fixed execution diagram and task descriptions.

loop_0_implement.output: Implemented all 8 tasks: DB migration, IPC handler, preload bridge, listAccounts color field, default color assignment, Settings UI, EmailList indicators, TaskList indicators.

converge.output: Verified all acceptance criteria. Found and fixed hex validation bug (frontend uppercase accepted but backend rejected). Quality: 13/14 (93%).
